item.subject: Booking HBR-12 confirmed

item.body: Brother Tom brings albums. Catering $300 for twelve, including two dairy-free meals. June prefers an early dinner at 17:00. Caterer asks for dietary counts.

turns: My brother can bring the photo albums. The originals go home with him and nothing from them gets posted online. We still need a meal plan.
